set_piece.name: The Wall
set_piece.playtest_pointer: Third Way Initiation beats 8-12 per watch/inbox/BURN_third-way-game_20260925.md: both faction passes refused, walk option appears, toll paid, no fight offered

stone_inscription.full_text: ASCEND NOT AS A WALL. This fence has two sides: neither force the end, nor flee from it.

lineage.source_named: Ketubot 111a, the three vows (not to ascend as a wall, not to rebel against the kingdoms, not to force the end)
lineage.no_fabrication_note: no verse text is quoted or asserted verbatim; no Talmud source fetch was in scope this pass

design_notes: The fence line is two-sided on purpose: forcing the end is barred by the Ketubot lineage, and fleeing from it is barred by the LeGuin chair (a Third Way that only exits is cowardice with a class name, per watch/inbox/STORYTELLER_SIX_RACTOR_20260925.md).
The Wall refuses both faction passes and offers no fight; the only violence it answers is the forced attempt, which triggers the debuff below.

trigger.logic: conjunction: both required, neither alone fires it

name_derivation.source_named: Sanhedrin 97b, stated reason: when a calculated date arrives and is failed, waiting collapses into he-will-never-come
name_derivation.no_fabrication_note: the debuff name is the design's plain-English rendering of that reason, not a translation of any quoted verse

towel_interaction.canon: Adams chair, watch/inbox/STORYTELLER_SIX_RACTOR_20260925.md: a real item, printed DON'T PANIC, that counters the despair debuff

wall_clearance.design_note: the stop is on forcing, not on trying: the debuff punishes the forced climb, so the attempt itself, right or wrong, is what lifts it
